title: DFT relaxation of Pmn2₁ and Pmmn structures
action: Build initial monolayer As2S3 structures in the polar Pmn2₁ and high-symmetry Pmmn phases from the bulk orpiment crystal structure. Perform DFT structural relaxation of both phases using the PBE functional in Quantum ESPRESSO, yielding optimized atomic coordinates and cell parameters.
description: Obtain relaxed ground-state geometries for the Pmn2₁ and Pmmn phases of monolayer As2S3.

title: Phonon calculation on Pmmn structure
action: Perform a density-functional perturbation theory (DFPT) phonon calculation on the relaxed Pmmn structure at the Γ point using Quantum ESPRESSO. Extract the normalized eigenvectors of all zone‑center soft phonon modes, in particular the B2u mode.
description: Identify soft optical modes at Γ and obtain the normalized eigenvector of the B2u phonon mode.

title: Spontaneous polarization calculation
action: Using the relaxed Pmn2₁ structure, compute the spontaneous electric polarization along the x‑axis via the Berry‑phase method in Quantum ESPRESSO.
description: Obtain the spontaneous polarization value (in pC/m) of the ferroelectric Pmn2₁ phase.

title: Piezoelectric coefficients calculation
action: Using the relaxed Pmn2₁ structure, perform a DFPT calculation in Quantum ESPRESSO to obtain the piezoelectric strain coefficients d11 and d12 (units: pm/V). Record the computed values in the evidence file piezo_output.txt.
description: Compute the piezoelectric strain coefficients d11 and d12 for monolayer As2S3 in the Pmn2₁ phase.

title: Soft-mode projection and final results
action: Compute the atomic displacement vector ΔR between the relaxed Pmmn and Pmn2₁ structures. Project ΔR onto the normalized B2u eigenvector to obtain the overlap fraction η(B2u). Compile η(B2u), the spontaneous polarization from step s3, and the piezoelectric coefficients d11 and d12 from step s3b into a single JSON artifact results.json.
description: Final scored artifact containing the soft-mode projection η_B2u (unitless), the spontaneous polarization (pC/m), and the piezoelectric strain coefficients d11 and d12 (pm/V).
output_schema: JSON object with keys: eta_B2u (float, unitless), polarization (float, in pC/m), d11 (float, in pm/V), d12 (float, in pm/V). Example: {"eta_B2u": 0.86, "polarization": 71.0, "d11": 55.7, "d12": -17.4}
